concept_options.title: What If You Doubled Your Money Every Day?
concept_options.hook: Every midnight, your money doubles. Day thirty-one at a pier kiosk: you hold out your phone and the balance runs off the screen, across the counter. Tonight it doubles again.
concept_options.visual_approach: a pier kiosk at night, the city across the bay behind: you large at the left, grinning, the phone held out, its balance (1073741824) spilling off the screen as split-flap digit tiles over the counter; Mrs. Vance behind the counter holding out a paper cup, shocked. Three thumbnail candidates a, b, c differ in the tag (DAY 31., NO BRAKES., EVERYTHING.)
concept_options.why_this_works: The topic title from the 2026-11-11 slate (f-money-doubles, 90/100, ranked 1st); the owner's pick; pairs with thumbnail a (DAY 31.)
